ios.desc:
Castamatic is the best app to listen to podcasts on iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Quickly assemble a custom sequence of episodes or create a smart playlist, and enjoy your favorite shows with enhanced audio quality thanks to Castamatic's machine learning Auto-leveler.

New in Castamatic 13: on-device intelligence powered by Apple Intelligence. Generate full episode transcripts, automatically create chapters, and follow along with a live-scrolling transcript panel — all processed privately on your device.

Highlights
---------------
Magic Transcript: generate full episode transcripts directly on your device. Tap any line to jump to that exact moment.

Magic Chapters: automatically split episodes into chapters using on-device AI, even when the podcast doesn't include them.

Transcript Panel: follow along with a live-scrolling transcript right in the player, with full transport controls.

Key Features
---------------
-Chapters: quickly jump to favorite topics. Works with published chapter marks and AI-generated Magic Chapters.

-Smart playlists with priority shows.

-"On the Go" Playlist: quickly pick shows for the next listening session.

-Support your favorite producers with Podcasting 2.0 and Value4Value.

-Live podcasts: listen to live shows and get notified the moment they go live.

-Podping: receive new episodes immediately after they are published.

-Full support for Siri shortcuts.

-Automatic Leveler: increase audio level consistency between different parts/voices of each show, without altering original audio character.

-Adaptive Gap-Zapper: increase play speed without losing intelligibility by shortening silent parts.

-Streaming: spare network traffic downloading only the parts you want to play. Or automatically download episodes as soon as they are published.

-Apple Watch: control playback, volume, pick episodes, and adjust audio effects from the watch.

-CarPlay: take your favorite shows with you in your car.

-iCloud sync: sync subscriptions and playhead position across all your devices.

-Backup and restore: manual and automatic backups keep your data safe.

-Custom AudioUnit player: maximum performance and minimal battery drain.

-Serverless design: Castamatic will keep on working until there are podcasts to listen to on planet Earth.

Subscription (in app purchase)
-------------
Castamatic is free to use. An optional subscription supports indie development, hides the Premium banner and unlocks extra features.

quotes.text:
Yeah, based on Bitcoin lightning (which is quite different from normal bitcoin) meaning no transaction costs and very low energy use. Basically it happens off-chain until someone syncs-up (then it becomes a btc transaction). It makes payments in fractions of cents possible, ie I stream 10 sats/min which is about 60 Eur cent per minute (so 1 cent per second).

You can also send messages to creators and attach amounts (those are called boosts), so you'd send a short message and attach 10k sats (or whatever you want), which is about 10 euros/dollars.

Some podcasts I listen to use this to read messages on the show (the highest ones). It's fun and casual but remains highly technical for now, https://getalby.com/ takes away some friction (but you're still self hosing a lightning wallet using docker compose). Easiest I think is Fountain [0, 1], which has it all built in. But I never tried that, I use Castamatic [2] with Alby.

I have to say, it seems to divide the Linux podcast world a bit with some shows embracing this, and some just calling it crypto-bs. A well, people seem to enjoy it and creators get real value, enough to have to rely less on ads even. I think this is one of the babies we'd throw out if we banned crypto currencies (which I agree are 99.999% bs).

quotes.text:
I put some money on a BTC Lightning wallet, now when I stream a podcast (creator to me), I stream satoshis/minute back. Literally value for value (I use Castamatic [0]). This was always the promise of defi for me. I'm glad it wasn't made illegal, it's starting to move into a useful domain where you can pay creators without friction and perhaps we can then finally get rid of ads (where we want) as the only viable model. I hope this can help indie podcasts from being gobbled up by Spotify, YouTube, etc.

And if you are afraid stuff will be unreachable for some people, the default for the podcasts are 40 sats/min (0.02 cents/min) atm. An yes, it is still difficult to get money into a Lightning wallet, I hope that will change.

These inventions only add to the freedom of creators to make their creations available under their own terms.

[0]: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/castamatic-podcast-player/id966632553
